subject.title: fix: show readable session names across Windows UX

question: Should Windows hide Gateway-classified background sessions by default across chat, tray, and dashboard while consuming the still-open upstream presentation contract?
rationale: The readable-title fix is well supported, but default filtering changes which existing sessions users can find and the permanent cross-repository contract has not yet landed.

options.title: Approve after contract and proof
options.body: Finalize the upstream contract, capture current-head native Windows proof, and explicitly approve the proposed default filtering before merging the complete PR.

options.title: Narrow to readable titles
options.body: Land presentation parsing and friendly titles while preserving existing visibility, then review background filtering as a separate product change.

options.title: Accept coordinated landing risk
options.body: Merge both repositories in a controlled order and intentionally accept the new default visibility behavior with release-facing upgrade context.

recommendation.title: Approve after contract and proof
recommendation.body: Finalize the upstream contract, capture current-head native Windows proof, and explicitly approve the proposed default filtering before merging the complete PR.

likelyOwner.reason: They are coordinating both the Windows implementation and the upstream session-presentation contract and can provide the most direct implementation and compatibility context for the decision.
